# Devot

> Local-first Markdown notes for Mac and iPhone: live preview, end-to-end encrypted sync, plugins, themes and MCP for AI tools.

This file is the summary for agents reading the source repository.
The public summary is [https://devot.online/llms.txt](https://devot.online/llms.txt).
The product site is [https://devot.online](https://devot.online).

Devot keeps notes in a SQLite database on the device.
Writing, organising and searching work offline, with no Devot account.
A 30-day trial unlocks every feature.
After the trial, notes can still be read, searched by keyword, copied and exported.
Editing, sync, semantic search and AI then need a licence.
A licence bought once unlocks them on up to three devices at a time, in every version.
The source is FSL-1.1-MIT.
A build from source checks no licence.
Each release becomes MIT two years after it is published.
Versions up to v1.0.4 stay MIT.

The live price is at [https://devot.online/#pricing](https://devot.online/#pricing).

## Platforms

- Mac: macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel, one universal app. Signed and notarised builds are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jma49/devot/releases/latest).
- iPhone and iPad: the App Store build. iOS 26 or later. The iPad runs the same screens, in columns when the window is wide.
- Languages in the app: English and Simplified Chinese.

## What it does

- Live preview of GitHub-flavoured Markdown, with code, math, Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams, and tables edited from the keyboard.
- Nestable notebooks, coloured tags, note statuses, pinning, Trash, templates and today's note.
- Full-text search, including words in attached images, on the device. Related by Meaning uses the system's on-device model.
- Note links, backlinks and a graph.
- End-to-end encrypted sync through the owner's iCloud, or through a relay the owner runs. Each note is sealed on the device before it leaves.
- Share on Web: an encrypted, read-only page with an expiry. The key travels only in the link.
- Plugins and themes on Mac. The iPhone can display plugin drawings synced from a Mac.
- MCP on the Mac, inside Devot's own binary, for Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop and other clients. Only notebooks the owner marks Allow AI Access are visible.

## Boundaries

- Sync uses no Devot account, and Devot's sync path does not store note text on a Devot server.
- MCP is not a hosted server. There is no public MCP URL.
- The iPhone does not run plugins.
- The Mac download is a Developer ID build from GitHub Releases.
- A hosted relay for people who do not want to run one is not built.
